idle_relaxed.label: עמידה רגועה
idle_relaxed.notes: Quiet breathing, slightly asymmetric low hands, relaxed knees and fixed feet.

jog.label: ג׳וג
jog.notes: Original analytic alternating gait; every stance has a world-fixed sole anchor. Pelvis and shoulders counter-rotate; compact bent elbows swing opposite the advancing thigh.

run.label: ריצה
run.notes: Original analytic alternating gait; every stance has a world-fixed sole anchor. Pelvis and shoulders counter-rotate; compact bent elbows swing opposite the advancing thigh.

idle_scan.label: עמידה וסריקה
idle_scan.notes: Eyes and head scan before the chest; arms stay alongside the torso and both soles remain planted.

idle_weight_shift.label: העברת משקל בעמידה
idle_weight_shift.notes: Slow lateral transfer of body mass between feet, without replanting or a wide arm pose.
